name: Portal
summary: A light editorial-iOS system with a twilight gradient hero, Perfectly Nineties serif headings, Inter UI text, one iOS-blue functional accent, rounded white cards, floating nav capsule, and pale glow-ring elevation.
coreMoves: Use one full-bleed dusk gradient hero.
Use a floating white nav capsule with pale glow ring.
Use Perfectly Nineties-style serif headings only at display sizes.
Use Inter for all UI, body, buttons, and labels.
Reserve Signal Blue for functional states and actions.
Use rounded white cards on an Ash Mist canvas.
Use pale outline glow rings instead of heavy drop shadows.

display.usage: H1 and H2 display headings only
